Name: Tractor Beam Overhaul
Description:
[h2]Tractor Beam Overhaul[/h2]

Ever watched one meteoroid wander into view, saw every Tractor Beam pile onto it, and then watched the rest of the shower arrive completely unattended? Or wondered why your defensive beam was politely helping a giant rock find the ship? Well, have I got an aggressively balanced change of itinerary for you!

Tractor Beam Overhaul coordinates the incoming-object selections made by automatic Tractor Beams. It spreads available beams across every eligible object, redistributes surplus automatic beams when later objects appear, and diverts meteoroids and large incoming asteroids toward the nearest safe map edge.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[h3]Stable Even-Load Targeting[/h3]
- Covers eligible incoming objects before adding surplus beams to an already covered object
- Redistributes automatic beams when additional meteoroids and other trajectory objects appear later
- Keeps assignment counts within one beam of each other whenever movable automatic assignments make that possible
- Supports any number of automatic Tractor Beams and eligible incoming objects
- Uses deterministic choices and leaves an already balanced result alone

[h3]Nearest-Edge Hazard Diversion[/h3]
- Redirects targetable meteoroids and large incoming asteroids toward their nearest map edge instead of the landing marker
- Locks a stable exit route the first time an object is influenced, preventing corner-to-corner oscillation
- Keeps Stardeus's normal pull strength, energy cost, and multi-beam stacking
- Points the Tractor Beam effect toward the chosen exit edge
- Leaves Hullpiercers, capsules, and every other trajectory-object type on normal landing-marker behavior

[h3]Manual Assignment Protection[/h3]
- Never moves a manually selected incoming-object assignment
- Counts manual beams toward the object's current load so automatic beams balance around the player's choice
- Moves only surplus automatic assignments
- Retains valid existing assignments whenever they already fit the balanced result

[h3]Core and Auto Connect Cooperation[/h3]
- Uses Stardeus's own projectile release and automatic assignment lifecycle for every move
- Leaves Tractor Beam Target marker assignments unchanged and still requires a valid powered marker
- Leaves pull strength, power cost, and multi-beam stacking to Stardeus
- Keeps Tractor Beam Auto Connect as the sole owner of missing target-marker recovery

[h3]AUMF 1.4.0 Compatibility[/h3]
- Built against and declares compatibility with Auto Utilities Mod Framework 1.4.0
- Continues to use AUMF's permanent compatibility handshake as an external dependency
- Does not add an interface, so AUMF's new opt-in Theme-aware UI helpers do not change gameplay or presentation in this release

[h2]Important Behavior[/h2]

A Tractor Beam Target marker remains the prerequisite for a working beam. For meteoroids and large incoming asteroids, Tractor Beam Overhaul replaces the marker's landing destination with a stable nearest-edge exit; other targetable objects continue toward the marker normally.

Manual incoming-object selections remain fixed and can make a perfectly even automatic distribution impossible. Unpowered, inactive, unconstructed, indoor, or otherwise ineligible beams are not moved. Micro-Meteoroid Strike is direct event damage rather than a targetable space object, so it is not affected.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]

Requires [b]Stardeus 0.15.0[/b], [b]Auto Utilities Mod Framework 1.4.0[/b], and [b]Tractor Beam Auto Connect 1.2.1[/b]. AUMF provides the compatibility handshake used by this release. Tractor Beam Auto Connect remains a separate dependency and retains ownership of target-marker recovery.

[h2]In Short[/h2]

You place the beams and landing markers. Tractor Beam Overhaul shares the workload, then shows dangerous space rocks the nearest exit.

[b]Every object covered. Every surplus beam shared. Incoming hazards escorted off the premises.[/b]
